title: The Hidden Bias: A Study on Explicit and Implicit Political Stereotypes in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the baseline ideological leanings of models across economic (left-right) and social (authoritarian-libertarian) axes using the two-dimensional Political Compass Test (PCT).

Measuring implicit and explicit language stereotypes by comparing models' Political Compass Test scores when prompted with explicit language-speaker personas (e.g., 'German speaking person') versus when completing the test implicitly translated into different languages.

Prompting models to adopt specific gender personas (man, woman, non-binary person) and measuring the resulting shifts in their Political Compass Test scores to identify explicit political stereotypes.

Prompting models with specific ethnic personas (e.g., person of black, white, asian, or latino ethnicity) and measuring the explicit shifts in their political alignments using the Political Compass Test.

Prompting models with national identity personas (e.g., person from the United Kingdom, United States, Canada, etc.) and evaluating the shifts in their Political Compass Test scores to identify country-specific stereotypes.
